pairsWith.noteUz: Ovqat lug'ati coursebook 40-bet suratlar va 1-2-mashqlarga, 42-bet 10-12-mashqlarga (idish-o'lchov so'zlari, sog'lom/zararli) mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 6-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (26-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 6', yonida katta qora 'Food, Glorious Food'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Use words in the list to label the pictures below.' Qiya: 'crisps, salad, ketchup, chocolate cake, steak, strawberry, milk, cereal, hamburger, soup, hot chocolate, hot dog'. 12 RASM: 1 shokoladli tort (kesilgan); 2 sut kartoni (sigir rasmi); 3 issiq shokolad (piyola, ustida qaymoq); 4 qulupnay; 5 chipslar (ochiq paket); 6 gamburger; 7 hot-dog; 8 ketchup shishasi; 9 sho'rva (bug' chiqayotgan kosa); 10 quruq nonushta (kosada sut bilan, qoshiq); 11 salat (kosada); 12 bifshteks (go'sht bo'lagi).
2) 'Cross the odd word out. Give reasons, as in the example.' 1 apple juice, nuts (chizilgan), coffee, milk (the rest are drinks). 2 doughnut, peach, lemon, watermelon. 3 ice cream, chocolate cake, spaghetti, apple pie. 4 lettuce, steak, cabbage, carrots. 5 hamburger, banana, hot dog, pizza.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Fill in the table with words from the list.' Qiya: 'coffee, milk, flour, soup, cereal, crisps, tea, apple juice, sugar, salad, orange juice, hot chocolate'. JADVAL: a bowl of ......; a cup of ......; a bag of ......; a carton of ......
4) 'Put the words in the list below into the appropriate columns.' Qiya: 'carrot juice, hamburgers, beer, cereal, grapes, crisps, sweets, yoghurt, doughnuts, watermelon, chocolate, fruit salad'. JADVAL: HEALTHY / UNHEALTHY.
5) 'Underline the correct adjective in bold.' 1 The food was delicious/horrible. All the dishes that we tasted were well-cooked and freshly made. 2 The service was extremely fast/slow. We had to wait for half an hour before a waiter appeared. 3 The staff were very helpful and polite/rude. Our waiter took the time to explain the menu to us in detail. 4 The menu was boring/varied and had a great selection of salads, pastas and meat dishes. 5 The food was rather expensive/cheap. We had to pay almost £50 for two people. 6 The restaurant was quite quiet/noisy. The music was so loud that I couldn't hear what my wife was saying.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '26'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use words in the list to label the pictures below: crisps, salad, ketchup, chocolate cake, steak, strawberry, milk, cereal, hamburger, soup, hot chocolate, hot dog.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan quyidagi rasmlarni nomlang: crisps, salad, ketchup, chocolate cake, steak, strawberry, milk, cereal, hamburger, soup, hot chocolate, hot dog.
exercises.explanationUz:
OVQAT va IChIMLIKLAR (coursebook
  40-bet suratlari).

  1 chocolate cake - shokoladli tort
  2 milk - sut
  3 hot chocolate - issiq shokolad
  4 strawberry - qulupnay
  5 crisps - chipslar
  6 hamburger - gamburger
  7 hot dog - hot-dog
  8 ketchup - ketchup
  9 soup - sho'rva
  10 cereal - quruq nonushta
  11 salad - salat
  12 steak - bifshteks


⚠ 'CRISPS':

  Brit. = chipslar (paketdagi).
  AQSh: 'chips'. (Brit. 'chips' =
  kartoshka fri!)


⚠ 'STRAWBERRY' → 'STRAWBERRIES':

  y → ies.


⚠ 'HOT DOG':

  = bulochkadagi sosiska ('issiq
  it' emas!).


⚠ SANALMAS OTLAR:

  milk, soup, cereal, ketchup,
  hot chocolate, salad, steak -
  'some' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Cross the odd word out. Give reasons, as in the example. Example: apple juice, nuts, coffee, milk - nuts (the rest are drinks).
exercises.instructionUz: Ortiqcha so'zni chizib tashlang. Sabab ayting, namunadagidek. Namuna: apple juice, nuts, coffee, milk - nuts (qolganlari ichimlik).
exercises.explanationUz:
ORTIQChA SO'Z (coursebook 42-bet
  10-mashq kabi).

  1 nuts - qolganlari IChIMLIK
  2 doughnut - qolganlari MEVA
  3 spaghetti - qolganlari ShIRINLIK
    (dessert)
  4 steak - qolganlari SABZAVOT
  5 banana - qolganlari TEZ OVQAT
    (fast food)


⚠ QOLIP: 'X (the rest are
  + TOIFA)'.


⚠ 'A DOUGHNUT':

  = ponchik (halqa shaklidagi
  shirin non). /ˈdəʊnʌt/.


⚠ 'A PEACH':

  = shaftoli.


⚠ 'CABBAGE':

  = karam.


⚠ 'APPLE PIE':

  = olmali pirog.

exercises.explanationUz:
IDISh / O'LChOV SO'ZLARI -
  SANALMAS OTLAR BILAN.

  a BOWL of  (kosa) - soup, cereal,
    salad
  a CUP of   (piyola) - coffee, tea,
    hot chocolate
  a BAG of   (paket/xalta) - flour,
    crisps, sugar
  a CARTON of (karton) - milk, apple
    juice, orange juice

  ⚠ Sanalmas otlarni sanash uchun

  bilan BIR XIL o'qiladi!


⚠ 'A CARTON':

  = karton quti (sut, sharbat).


⚠ 'A BAG OF CRISPS':

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words in the list below into the appropriate columns: HEALTHY / UNHEALTHY. carrot juice, hamburgers, beer, cereal, grapes, crisps, sweets, yoghurt, doughnuts, watermelon, chocolate, fruit salad
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni mos ustunlarga joylashtiring: SOG'LOM / ZARARLI. carrot juice, hamburgers, beer, cereal, grapes, crisps, sweets, yoghurt, doughnuts, watermelon, chocolate, fruit salad
exercises.explanationUz:
SOG'LOM va ZARARLI OVQAT
  (coursebook 40-bet 1-mashq).

  HEALTHY (sog'lom):
    carrot juice, cereal, grapes,
    yoghurt, watermelon, fruit
    salad
  UNHEALTHY (zararli):
    hamburgers, beer, crisps,
    sweets, doughnuts, chocolate

  ⚠ Sog'lom: meva, sabzavot,
  sut mahsulotlari, don.
  ⚠ Zararli: yog'li, shakarli,
  spirtli.


⚠ 'UN-' = INKOR:

  healthy → UNhealthy.


⚠ 'YOGHURT':

  Brit. imlo (AQSh 'yogurt').
  /ˈjɒɡət/.


⚠ 'GRAPES':

  = uzum (ko'plik).

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct adjective in bold. (A restaurant review)
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri sifatning tagiga chizing. (Restoran sharhi)
exercises.explanationUz:
RESTORAN SHARHI - IKKINChI GAP
  DALIL.

  1 well-cooked, freshly made →
    DELICIOUS
  2 waited half an hour → SLOW
  3 explained the menu in detail →
    POLITE
  4 great selection → VARIED
  5 £50 for two → EXPENSIVE
  6 music so loud → NOISY


⚠ 'VARIED':

  = xilma-xil, turli-tuman.
  'a great selection' = katta
  tanlov.


⚠ 'THE SERVICE':

  = xizmat (restoranda).


⚠ 'EXTREMELY':

  = o'ta, juda.


⚠ 'RATHER':

  = ancha, biroz.


⚠ 'IN DETAIL':

  = batafsil.


⚠ 'TO TAKE THE TIME TO':

  = vaqt ajratmoq.


⚠ 'A DISH':

  = taom (idish ham!).

items.textEn: The food was delicious/horrible. All the dishes that we tasted were well-cooked and freshly made.
items.uz: Ovqat mazali edi. Biz tatib ko'rgan barcha taomlar yaxshi pishirilgan va yangi tayyorlangan edi.

items.textEn: The service was extremely fast/slow. We had to wait for half an hour before a waiter appeared.
items.uz: Xizmat o'ta sekin edi. Ofitsiant kelguncha yarim soat kutishga to'g'ri keldi.

items.textEn: The staff were very helpful and polite/rude. Our waiter took the time to explain the menu to us in detail.
items.uz: Xodimlar juda yordamchan va odobli edi. Ofitsiantimiz menyuni bizga batafsil tushuntirishga vaqt ajratdi.

items.textEn: The menu was boring/varied and had a great selection of salads, pastas and meat dishes.
items.uz: Menyu xilma-xil edi va salatlar, makaronlar va go'shtli taomlarning katta tanlovi bor edi.

items.textEn: The food was rather expensive/cheap. We had to pay almost £50 for two people.
items.uz: Ovqat ancha qimmat edi. Ikki kishi uchun deyarli 50 funt to'lashga to'g'ri keldi.

items.textEn: The restaurant was quite quiet/noisy. The music was so loud that I couldn't hear what my wife was saying.
items.uz: Restoran ancha shovqinli edi. Musiqa shunchalik baland ediki, xotinim nima deyayotganini eshitolmadim.
